summary: Multiple ballistic missile threats from Kursk region are reported, with potential attacks on Kyiv. Civilian infrastructure and military targets in eastern and southern Ukraine face ongoing strikes. Ukrainian forces report significant casualties and damage from drone and missile attacks.
key_points: Ballistic missile threats from Kursk region reported with 20% probability of night attack on Kyiv (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69372)
Ukrainian PPO forces intercepted 127 Russian drones and 2 H-59/69 rockets in Zaporizhzhia region (Source: @UkraineNow/82912)
10+ casualties reported in Kyiv region from Russian strikes, including children (Source: @tass_agency/387060)
Russian attacks on civilian infrastructure in Poltava and Sumy regions, including gas stations and residential buildings (Source: @UkraineNow/82912)
Russian forces reported using H-59/69 rockets and drones in attacks on military and civilian targets (Source: @UkraineNow/82912)
Russian missile strikes on energy infrastructure in Kherson region, damaging 900 sqm commercial building (Source: @UkraineNow/82912)
Russian forces reported mobilizing for new large-scale attacks within 48 hours (Source: @UkraineNow/82908)
Russian attacks on water supply infrastructure in Zaporizhzhia, killing one civilian (Source: @eRadarrua/102597)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces are escalating attacks using ballistic missiles and drones, targeting both military and civilian infrastructure. The Kursk region threat indicates potential for increased strategic targeting. Ukrainian forces are actively intercepting attacks but face significant operational pressure.
sections.regional_response: Ukrainian PPO forces are responding to missile and drone threats with interception operations. Civilian casualties and infrastructure damage suggest Russian forces are prioritizing terror tactics. International attention is needed to address escalation risks.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian forces are demonstrating increased use of ballistic missiles and drones in coordinated attacks. The Kursk region threat highlights potential for strategic targeting. Ukrainian military responses show capacity but limited resources to counter escalating threats.
